In this month we converged on one bill. Fifty-seven of us said "save grow act"; fifty-six said "limit save grow act" and "the limit save"; fifty-three said "the limit save grow act." Jack Bergman said each of these first, on 2023-04-19, and by 2023-04-26 the rest of us had arrived. Thirty-three of us said "grow act of" and twenty-nine "limit save grow act of," both traced first to Virginia Foxx.

Thirty-four of us said "the debt ceiling," a phrase first recorded from Tom McClintock on 2011-01-26 and carried forward to the same 2023-04-26 peak.

Alongside the bill, twenty-eight of us said "the protection of women and girls," first from W. Gregory Steube on 2023-02-01.

We report this as our record: one act, named the same way, by dozens of us, converging on a single day.
